title: Layers

note.general: Each layer is one measurement at this place. Tick a layer to show it; the mark beside its name shows its long-term change.
note.expert: Count, size and speed of each form follow this place's own record. K is shown as °C. Each slider sets opacity. Flow direction is illustrative: there is no wind data.

trendNote: Trend: linear change of monthly anomalies over each record. ▲ ▼ mark significant trends, ◇ not significant, and a crossed-out triangle a significant trend with a documented data issue (see its caution). Not significant does not mean no change.
